descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-02 Patient List Capture · S24 「照片 OCR 接到 Vertex Gemini，prompt 原样传过去」 Photo OCR is wired to Vertex Gemini and the prompt is passed unchanged

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T3 Photo and census scanning runs on Google Gemini Flash via Vertex AI.（TFA-94425 AC 1）
  • T4 The prototype's photo-reading instruction text is ported word for word. Only the request format changes, to fit Gemini's API.（TFA-94425 AC 2；TFA-94425 AC 3；TFA-94425 AC 4）

测试设计方法：等价类（equivalence） — 同一条规则换一类输入（医院 / 养老院、另一种数据）再验一次，每一类都要对。

Given Provider configuration (api project, no network)

When Read the default vision provider/model, route a photo, and build the Vertex request

Then Default vision provider is vertex with a Gemini Flash model. A photo goes to the configured vision model with the prompt text unchanged. The request is the native Vertex shape (prompt part + inline image, minimal thinking, high media resolution, temperature 0)

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：Playwright assertions in api/providers.spec.ts. These check defaults only. S19 records which model was requested; the model that answered is not logged for vision. Temperature 0 vs the prototype's 0.2 is Q12

在哪跑：本地 lane A（现成 Playwright 测试）；测试方法 API · 接口（Convex 函数）；矩阵里排的车道 现成测试（Tim 的 Playwright）（automated）

S24 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-02.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane A。

测试方法：API · 接口（Convex 函数）（API (Tim's providers spec, no network)）；辅助：CONFIG · 配置核对 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local (spec) + CONFIG on dev 跑；来源：matrix（lane A）。

  • api/providers.spec.ts [api] — builds the native Vertex photo OCR request with literal-reading controls — expected
